title: Define and validate implementation work manifests
goal: Introduce a strict versioned manifest contract for future implementation work units.
acceptance_tests: cmdr-dev validate-manifests succeeds on repository manifests

performance_budget.rationale: engineering control-plane operation; no product runtime performance claim

migration.rationale: no product runtime persistent data migration

verification: validate-manifests returns to the previous verified behavior

definition_of_ready: dependencies satisfy their required terminal state
authorized paths and goal are explicit
definition_of_done: manifest v2 has a machine-readable contract
unknown fields and invalid types are rejected
legacy schema-v1 manifests are accepted only for E0
all E1 manifests validate in CI
